footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 20-F for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 15.6% to $496M in 2025. Gross margin was 50.5%, versus 48.9% a year earlier, and operating income rose 18.6% to $128M, a 25.8% margin.
Net income fell 57.2% to $50.7M, or $1.04 per share. Operating cash flow was $142M and free cash flow $127M, versus $112M.
sources: Camtek Ltd. Form 20-F for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
